DataCalcInsightTemplate.expression: SELECT Tes_Individual__dlm.Id__c AS IndividualId__c, COUNT(Tes_Web_Engagement__dlm.event_id__c) AS EngagementScore__c FROM Tes_Web_Engagement__dlm JOIN Tes_ContactPointEmail__dlm ON Tes_ContactPointEmail__dlm.EmailAddress__c = Tes_Web_Engagement__dlm.email__c JOIN Tes_Individual__dlm ON Tes_Individual__dlm.Id__c = Tes_ContactPointEmail__dlm.PartyId__c GROUP BY Tes_Individual__dlm.Id__c
